newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan aluminium futures end mixed after quiet day.
newsitem.headline: Japan aluminium futures end mixed after quiet day.

text.p: Japanese yen-based aluminium futures closed mixed on Thursday after a quiet day dominated by inter-month arbitrage, traders said.

"We've seen quite a lot of inter-month arbitrage after strong gains on Thursday," one trader said. "Sentiment is turning better, with no major resistance seen before $1,630 on the LME (London Metal Exchange)."
The June contract lost 0.4 yen to 190.9 yen and the April was down 0.3 yen to 192.5 yen, while the December contract added 0.5 yen to 194.4 and February 1.2 yen to 194.1 yen.

In London overnight, three-month aluminium finished up $7 at $1,610 per tonne, defending the key $1,600 level as the market tackled overhead resistance and producer selling. -- Tokyo Commodities +81-3-3432-6179
